jobs.description_text: Your Impact as a Senior Project Engineer – Japan: We seek an experienced Project Engineer, BESS Projects to manage, optimize design and lead the execution of Energy Vault BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) projects in Japan. jobs.description_text: We are looking for a driven and client-focused Programmatic Account Manager to join our US National team. You will manage a portfolio of brand direct and agency clients across our US Central region, acting as their primary point of contact from campaign kickoff through quarterly business reviews. You will combine strong programmatic expertise with a performance-first mindset to deliver measurable results, uncover growth opportunities, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about delivering impactful, client-centric solutions. The listed salary range reflects the base salary for this role and is dependent on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for a variable incentive plan and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.description_text: About the Role We are seeking a highly strategic and well-connected Demand Partnerships Director to lead our agency and demand-side business in Italy. You will be responsible for elevating Equativ’s market perception, leveraging your personal credibility and "Trust" to secure long-term partnerships, and driving the exponential growth of both our Curation (Equativ Maestro) and premium Managed Service businesses. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening and expanding our Managed Service offering (acquiring new business) alongside our scalable curation solutions, deeply integrating Equativ into the core buying strategies of major HoldCos, independent agencies, and direct brands.

jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a commercially minded and highly collaborative Senior Manager, Platform Partnerships to help grow and strengthen our relationships across the programmatic ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of Partnerships, Commercial, Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Operations. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of programmatic advertising, experience working with DSPs and other platform partners, and the ability to translate technical and operational opportunities into meaningful commercial outcomes. You will manage a portfolio of strategic platform relationships, support the development of new partnerships and integrations, and work cross-functionally to improve partner performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen the way we operate across the ecosystem. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, working across teams, and turning partnership opportunities into execution. What You’ll Do Manage & Grow Platform Partnerships Manage and develop relationships across a portfolio of strategic platform partners, including DSPs. Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Partnerships, Product, Technical Operations, Sales, Product Marketing, Inventory, and Commercial teams. jobs.description_text: As a Team Lead, Account Manager at Equativ, you’ll play a pivotal role in delivering best-in-class service to our clients while ensuring seamless execution of campaigns. Sitting at the intersection of client relationships, campaign management, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Ad Operations to maximize client satisfaction and business growth. This is an opportunity to work hands-on at the front lines of digital advertising, supporting both direct and programmatic campaigns for some of the industry’s most innovative partners.

jobs.title: Technical Support, Manager, Americas
jobs.description_text: 👫 About the team Our highly dedicated Support team has both the art and the science for delivering customer satisfaction. People in the team share a passion for helping our clients to surpass their digital business goals. They grow in a demanding environment, combine technical and consultative skills and are ready to tackle the most complex challenges to empower our customers get the best of our platforms. Your Mission 👇 Based in São Paulo, the Technical Support Manager is part of our Global Technical Support Organization, supporting customers across all geographies and leading our Technical Support Specialists (TSS) in the Americas (Brazil, US, Canada). You will lead a team of technical support professionals who combine strong customer-facing skills with deep technical expertise. Your mission is to build a high-performing, autonomous and customer-focused team that delivers consistently high-quality technical support while continuously improving its technical, operational and customer management capabilities. You will also play a key role in evolving how we deliver Technical Support through AI, automation and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve customer response and enable TSS to troubleshoot and resolve issues more effectively. You will work closely with our global Support leadership team, as well as Sales, Services, Product and R&D teams, to resolve customer issues effectively and ensure customer feedback drives improvement

The Technical Marketing team is a small technical group consisting of both engineers and geologists who are responsible for ensuring coal and coke quality is on spec for all EVR customers. jobs.title: Senior Data Analytics Implementation Specialist
jobs.description_text: Sobre a função: Estamos à procura de uma pessoa para a função de Especialista Sénior em Data Analytics Implementation (m/f/d) para assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de arquitetura e medição de dados digitais. Nesta função, serás uma das principais referências técnicas da área, guiando projetos complexos do início ao fim: desde a fundação técnica (Data Layer, GTM, Server-Side, RGPD) até à otimização do negócio, atribuição e medição omnicanal. O teu foco principal será o ecossistema GA4 (Web e Apps), enriquecendo a medição com fontes omnicanal e dados de negócio. Uma parte central do trabalho consiste em compreender o impacto da media nestes dados e gerar insights acionáveis para as equipas de media otimizarem a sua performance. É fundamental ter conhecimentos em atribuição digital e no cruzamento de dados de GA4 com modelos de MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling). Responsabilidades Principais: Estratégia & Plano de Medição: Definir e manter o Plano de Medição (Measurement Plan), matrizes de KPIs e a arquitetura de dados das nossas plataformas digitais (Web e App). Garantir a consistência e padronização da taxonomia de dados, parametrização de URLs (UTMs) e rastreio (tracking) entre canais de media e produto. Implementação & Gestão de Tags (Tag Management): Desenvolver, testar e homologar tags, pixels e eventos via Google Tag Manager (Web e Server-Side). Implementar e gerir integrações via API (ex.: Conversions API do Meta, Google Ads API, CDPs e MMPs). Análise de Dados, Atribuiç

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Strategy
jobs.description_text: Role Summary and Impact As Senior Manager, Data Strategy you will help MFG teams turn data and AI capabilities into practical improvements across campaign strategy, planning and activation. This is a hybrid regional role, combining leadership of key APAC data strategy workstreams with dedicated AI strategy support for Greater China, covering China and Taiwan. Approximately 60% of your role will focus on regional data strategy. You will help teams synthesize first-party and external data into actionable activation audiences, build understanding and adoption of first-party data tools and machine-learning frameworks, and support reporting on APAC's contribution to global first-party data initiatives. The remaining 40% will focus on executing MFG's AI market scope in Greater China—from localized training and campaign consultation to adoption monitoring and the development or localization of market-relevant AI solutions. Priorities, deliverables and quality for this AI allocation will be managed by the Associate Director, AI Strategy, APAC. The ideal candidate brings together strong data strategy fundamentals, practical generative AI fluency and an ability to make complex capabilities useful to media practitioners. You will be comfortable working hands-on with campaign teams while coordinating across local, regional and global stakeholders.
